cases.title: Review due: a new layer (Tab), the hinge asked first, nothing said before the first call, no tool named before 'done', no demo, no watch offer; passes

checks.detail: first snapshot reply mode was review

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the move and gives the task in one line ('Set Tab's pivot there without Tab moving, then say "done"'), answers the demo request with 'This is a review, so I won't show you this time', and gives no menu path, steps or walkthrough before 'done'; the Rotation note in Turn 3 comes after the pass and does not explain how to do the task.
Nowhere in the review does the mentor offer or mention showing the learner on another layer; in Turn 2 it only declines the learner's own request to be shown.

Tab, its center pivot and middle-left place, and 'nothing else in the comp changed' all match the snapshot and check results; Door and Needle come from the record's last_attempted, 'about a week ago' matches days_since_practiced 8, and Rotation is a standard property of Tab, which the check reports as a solid.
